questions.question: Find the acute angle between the hour and minute hands at 3:40.
questions.explanation: Use formula 30H - 5.5M and take absolute value.
stepByStep: Step 1: Calculate hour hand position = 30(3) + 0.5(40) = 110 degrees.
Step 2: Calculate minute hand position = 6(40) = 240 degrees.
Step 3: Angle = |110 - 240| = 130 degrees.

questions.question: Determine the reflex angle between the hour and minute hands at 8:20.
questions.explanation: Find smaller angle first, then subtract from 360 to get reflex angle.
stepByStep: Step 1: Smaller angle = |30(8) - 5.5(20)| = |240 - 110| = 130 degrees.
Step 2: Reflex angle = 360 - 130 = 230 degrees.
Step 3: Correct option B matches 230 degrees.

questions.question: A clock is set right at 8:00 AM. It gains 5 minutes every 24 hours. What will be the correct time when this clock shows 4:00 PM on the following day?
questions.explanation: 20 hours passed on clock = 19 hours 56 min actual. Rate: 24 hr clock = 23 hr 55 min real. Correct time = 4:00 PM - 8 min.
stepByStep: Step 1: Find total time shown on clock from 8 AM to 4 PM next day = 20 hours.
Step 2: Use ratio 24:23.55 to find actual hours = 20 * (23.95/24) = 19 hr 52 min.
Step 3: Subtract from 4:00 PM to get 3:52 PM.

questions.question: A watch loses 3 minutes every 24 hours. It was set correctly at 10:00 AM on Monday. What will be the true time when the watch shows 4:00 PM on the following Monday?
questions.explanation: 54 hours on watch = 54 hr 3 min actual. True time = 4:00 PM - 6 min.
stepByStep: Step 1: Total time shown on watch from Mon 10 AM to next Mon 4 PM = 54 hours.
Step 2: Ratio 24:23.75. Actual hours = 54 * (23.75/24) = 53 hr 54 min.
Step 3: Subtract from 4:00 PM to find true time is 3:54 PM.

questions.question: A clock gains 10 minutes in 24 hours. It was set right at 6:00 AM. What will be the correct time when the clock shows 2:00 PM on the same day?
questions.explanation: 8 hours on fast clock = 7 hr 50 min actual. Correct time = 2:00 PM - 10 min.
stepByStep: Step 1: Time shown on clock = 8 hours (from 6 AM to 2 PM).
Step 2: Ratio 24:24.10. Actual hours = 8 * (23.9/24) = 7 hr 50 min.
Step 3: Subtract from 2:00 PM to get correct time 1:50 PM.

questions.question: A watch loses 5 minutes in 24 hours. It was set correctly at 7:00 AM. What is the true time when the watch shows 3:00 PM on the same day?
questions.explanation: 8 hours on slow clock = 7 hr 55 min actual. True time = 3:00 PM - 5 min.
stepByStep: Step 1: Time shown on watch = 8 hours (from 7 AM to 3 PM).
Step 2: Ratio 24:23.9167. Actual hours = 8 * (23.9167/24) = 7 hr 55 min.
Step 3: Subtract from 3:00 PM to find true time is 2:55 PM.

questions.question: A clock gains 15 minutes in 24 hours. It was set right at 9:00 AM. What will be the correct time when this clock shows 12:00 PM (noon) on the same day?
questions.explanation: 3 hours on fast clock = 2 hr 55 min actual. Correct time = 12:00 PM - 5 min.
stepByStep: Step 1: Time elapsed on clock = 3 hours (from 9 AM to 12 PM).
Step 2: Ratio 24:23.75. Actual hours = 3 * (23.75/24) = 2 hr 55 min.
Step 3: Subtract from 12:00 PM to get correct time 11:55 AM.
